response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile senior/staff engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, and infrastructure, and he holds a relevant CS degree. However, his resume shows almost no direct evidence of the core GenAI requirements for this role — no Python, no vector databases, no RAG architecture experience, no multi-agent framework work (LangGraph/CrewAI), and no AI system design on major cloud platforms. His only AI-adjacent exposure is a brief, vaguely described mention of MCP code generators and 'agentic workflow' tooling since April 2025, which is far short of the 8+ years of AI-solution development required.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, senior/staff-level software engineering experience across many stacks and domains
Recent (current) hands-on exposure to MCP and agentic workflow tooling, directly relevant to one listed key technology
Strong generalist skill set with demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, workshops, and open-source project ownership
concerns: No Python listed or referenced anywhere, despite it being a core required language for AI-driven development
No evidence of vector database usage, RAG architecture design, or LLM evaluation/observability experience
AI-specific experience is limited to ~1 year in current role with vague descriptions, far below the 8+ years of AI solution-building required

key_factors.factor: Insufficient years of dedicated AI-solution development (8+ yrs required)
Strong general staff-level engineering background and MCP exposure
